key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight. Default is Ctrl+Space.

key.name: theme-preference
key.description: Color theme for Spotlight. Values: default (follows system), dark, light.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Preferred width in pixels, capped at 85 percent of the active monitor width.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Dialog corner radius in pixels. Zero gives square corners.
